description: This file defines an abstract class `DashletGenericChart` which extends `Dashlet` within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It provides core functionalities for creating configurable, refreshable chart dashlets, including methods for rendering, saving options, fetching chart data, and sorting data. The class manages search fields, chart configuration templates, and interactions with seed beans and layout managers. It serves as a base class for specific chart dashlet implementations.

classes.name: DashletGenericChart
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating configurable, refreshable chart dashlets in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, providing core functionality for rendering, configuration, data retrieval, and sorting.

methods.name: getSeedBean
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the seed bean object associated with the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves the dashlet configuration options based on user input, including date and time formatting.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the configuration popup window, including search fields and refresh options.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code necessary for the dashlet, primarily for chart rendering.

methods.name: setRefreshIcon
methods.description: Returns HTML for a refresh icon if the dashlet is configurable and refreshable.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Stub method to generate the SQL query for fetching chart data; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Stub method to generate GROUP BY clause parameters; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the dashlet, including auto-refresh script.

methods.name: processAutoRefresh
methods.description: Generates HTML for auto-refresh functionality, parameterized by dashlet offset.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Fetches chart data from the database query result and returns it as an array.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Sorts and translates dataset rows based on specified columns and options.
